concepts.name: short_term_directional_bias
concepts.mechanical_proxy: direction of a displacement close beyond a prior consolidation

concepts.name: consolidation
concepts.mechanical_proxy: prior N bars have high-low width no greater than configured ATR multiple

concepts.name: displacement_breakout
concepts.mechanical_proxy: completed close beyond consolidation plus tick buffer and body at least ATR multiple

concepts.name: evolving_impulse_range
concepts.mechanical_proxy: origin is opposite consolidation boundary; extreme updates after each completed extension bar

concepts.name: fifty_percent_retest
concepts.mechanical_proxy: a later bar crosses the midpoint that was known before that bar began

concepts.name: rejection_or_engulfing
concepts.mechanical_proxy: optional close back through midpoint with directionally aligned candle; next-bar-open execution

concepts.name: fixed_or_pivotal_stop
concepts.mechanical_proxy: use origin beyond one tick if within 40 ticks of entry, otherwise fixed 40-tick stop

concepts.name: runner_target
concepts.source_status: EXPLICIT liquidity/equal-high concept; exact ranking UNCONFIRMED
concepts.mechanical_proxy: nearest active same-side confirmed liquidity beyond target one, otherwise 1.66 range extension

concepts.name: smt_divergence
concepts.source_status: EXPLICIT confluence; not stated as mandatory

concepts.name: fvg_ifvg
concepts.source_status: EXPLICIT discretionary context / missed hypothetical entry
concepts.mechanical_proxy: causal three-candle gap and close-through inversion

concepts.name: standard_deviation
concepts.source_status: EXPLICITLY NOT USED IN PRIMARY EXAMPLE

long: approved session and no risk kill
track higher extremes without using future bars
later touch of previously known 50% midpoint
spread, exposure, trade count, loss, and drawdown checks pass
entry.order_assumption: trigger-market at chart midpoint with half-spread plus slippage
entry.same_bar_assumption: stop can occur; no favorable exit on entry bar

management.partial: configured fraction at impulse extreme when integer quantity permits
management.after_partial: move stop on remainder to chart entry
management.intrabar_ambiguity: stop first; after partial, same-bar break-even stop is assumed if spanned

risk.sizing: floor(equity risk budget / stop-and-cost loss per contract); never score-weighted

no_trade_conditions: setup expired or closes through impulse origin
required optional context missing when enabled
risk budget cannot support one contract

data_and_testing.holdout_policy: locked unless strategy_frozen=true and explicit CLI consent
lookahead_controls: right-window pivots emitted only at confirmation bar
HTF bars emitted only when next bucket begins
consolidation and midpoint predate trigger bar
